Company Overview
Echo Neurotechnologies is an exciting new startup in the Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) space, driving innovation through advanced hardware engineering and AI solutions. Our mission is to deliver cutting-edge technologies that restore autonomy to people living with disabilities and improve their quality of life.
Team Culture
Join a small, dedicated team of knowledgeable and motivated professionals. Our early-stage environment offers the opportunity to take ownership of broad decisions with significant and long-lasting impact. We emphasize continuous learning and growth, fostering cross-functional collaboration where your contributions are vital to our success.
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer to build foundational applications powering our BCI product ecosystem. In this role, you will build high-performance user interfaces and backend services that bridge device telemetry, real-time neural data, and cloud connectivity. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate complex clinical requirements into secure, high-reliability software features.
Role Responsibilities
● Full Stack Development: Design, implement, and maintain high-quality software principally in Rust in a desktop environment, and occasionally including server and web interfaces.
● System Architecture & APIs: Design and implement robust APIs, secure data flows, and scalable solutions for real-time and batch time-series data.
● Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with firmware, ML, clinical, and product engineering teams to integrate client and server software seamlessly across the broader device ecosystem.
● Engineering Excellence & Process: Champion best practices across code quality, modular architecture, comprehensive documentation, and automated testing suites.
● Quality & Regulatory Compliance: Author and maintain design documentation, specifications, and verification protocols in alignment with medical software design controls.
Required Quali fi cations
●  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
●  3+ years of production software engineering experience spanning full-stack application development.
●  Strong proficiency in Rust or a similar language, with proficiency in Python.
●  Demonstrated experience with systems design, data flow architecture, performance-critical code, and API design.
● Clear understanding of software quality practices, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines in production environments.
●  Excellent communication skills and comfort driving technical solutions independently in an early-stage hardware/software environment.
Preferred Quali fi cations
●  Direct experience developing medical device software under design controls and quality standards (e.g., IEC 62304).
●  Hands-on experience building HIPAA-compliant platforms handling sensitive data (PHI / PII).
●  Familiarity with biological sensor data, time-series data, or neurophysiological signal processing workflows.
●  Experience implementing cybersecurity best practices for connected device ecosystems.
